title: Celestial Chalice Oracle
description: A surreal circular composition features a central blue-skinned female figure with white hair styled in buns, closed eyes, and blue liquid flowing from her open mouth. The liquid cascades downward into a waterfall that pours into ornate golden and pink chalices arranged in concentric rings on a metallic, grid-patterned disc. Floating glowing orbs and star-like sparkles surround the scene against a black background with beams of light descending from the top right.
